units.source_text: 里面的人突然看见一个穿便服的男子肃静无声、一派斯文地出现在眼前，

en.t: The people inside suddenly saw a man in plain clothes appear before them, silent, composed, and refined,

units.source_text: 只因一向不曾见惯，竟疑心他是狐狸化身。

en.t: and because they had never been used to seeing such a sight, they even suspected that he was a fox in human form.

units.source_text: 但见这男人走过来，开口言道：

en.t: Then they saw the man come forward and begin to speak:

units.source_text: “我是来探听你家小姐情况的。

en.t: I have come to inquire after your young lady.

units.source_text: 如果小姐不变初心，则我家公子至今也还有心来看她。

en.t: If your lady has not changed her heart, my lord still wishes even now to come and see her.

units.source_text: 今宵亦不忍空过，车驾停在门前。

en.t: He could not bear to let this evening pass in vain either, and his carriage is waiting at the gate.

units.source_text: 应该如何禀复，务请明以告我。

en.t: Please tell me plainly what answer I should bring back to him.
I am neither a fox nor a demon, so there is no need to be afraid!
The ladies in waiting all burst out laughing.
The old lady in waiting replied:

units.source_text: “我家小姐如果变心，早已乔迁别处，

en.t: If our young lady had changed her heart, she would long ago have moved somewhere else,

units.source_text: 不会住在这荒草丛中了。

en.t: and would not be living here among these wild grasses.

units.source_text: 请你推察实情，善为禀复。

en.t: Please understand the true state of things and report it kindly on our behalf.

units.source_text: 我们活了一把年纪的人，从来不曾见过如此可怜的生涯！”

en.t: Even we who have lived to such an age have never seen so pitiful a way of life!

units.source_text: 便不问自语，将种种困苦情状一五一十地告诉惟光。

en.t: Then, without being asked, she went on talking and told Koremitsu every detail of their many hardships.

units.source_text: 我立刻将此情况禀告公子就是了。”

en.t: I will report this situation to my lord at once.

units.source_text: 说着，便走出去向公子回话。

en.t: With that, he went out to give his lord the reply.
